spell.name: Belchy Bubble
spell.desc:
<Bright>Adaptor </Bright><Bright>:</Bright> Belch a noxious bubble at the current target that explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage. Enemies within a 1 hex radius of the explosion take @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage over @PoisonDurationAP@ seconds.

<dim>Adaptor </dim><dim>: Heavily slows the target.</dim>

Purple Buff: Every @TraitTimer@ seconds, Gromp gains @TraitTimedAP@ Ability Power.

spell.name: Rending Claws
spell.desc: Leap to the lowest Health enemy within @LeapHexRadius@ Hexes and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage. The next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks gain @EmpowerAspd@ Attack Speed and deal @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  bonus physical damage.\n\nGrey Buff: Gain Precision and @TraitBaseCrit@ Critical Strike Chance, increased up to @TraitBonusCrit@ based on missing Health.

spell.name: Azure Laser
spell.desc: Begin consuming @PercentManaPerSecond@ max Mana per second and channeling a laser on the target. Each second while casting, deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to them and reduce their Magic Resist by @MRReduction@.\n\nTeal Buff: Gain @TraitManaRegenTooltip@ Mana Regen for every @TraitChannelSecondsTooltip@ seconds channeled.

spell.name: Razor Leaves
spell.desc:
Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage and applying @WoundLevel@% <Keyword>Wound</Keyword> and @BurnAmount@% <Keyword>Burn</Keyword> for @WoundDuration@ seconds.

Scarlet Buff: Cinderling gains @TraitADOnCast@ Attack Damage each cast.

<rules>Wound: Reduces healing received.</rules>
<rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.</rules>

spell.name: Can You Dig It?
spell.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks are replaced by a dance that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage to all adjacent enemies.

<bright>Active:</bright> Burrow underground, gaining @BurrowDurability@ Durability for @BurrowDuration@ seconds and healing @HealthCalc1@  over the duration. 

Green Buff: When allies fall below @TraitHealthThreshold@ Health, they restore @TraitPercentHeal@ max Health.

spell.name: Rock and Roll
spell.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, split into two Kruglettes with @HealthCalc1@  Health which immediately taunt, forcing enemies to attack them.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @HealthCalc2@  max Health, then roll into the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  damage.

Slate Buff: On death, Krug and Kruglettes Shield allies for @TraitShieldHealth@ max Health.

spell.name: Azure Shockwave
spell.desc:
Gain @ShieldCalc1@  Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Slam the ground, sending a fissure in the direction of the most enemies. Enemies hit are briefly knocked up, take @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, and are <keyword>Mana Reaved</keyword> for @ManaReaveFlat@.

Blue Buff: Each time Sentinel casts, allies gain @TraitAlliesManaRegen@ Mana Regen.

<rules>Mana Reave: Increase the Mana cost of the next Ability cast.</rules>

spell.name: Crimson Fury
spell.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage.

<bright>Active:</bright> Gain @FrenzyADPercent@ Attack Damage for @Duration@ seconds. During this time ignore @GenericCalc1@  Armor.

Red Buff: Attacks @BurnAmount@% Burn enemies and heal Brambleback for @TraitMaxHealthHeal@ max Health.

spell.name: Deadly Plumage
spell.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with feathers that deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage and reduce Armor by @GenericCalc1@ .

spell.name: Bellows Breath
spell.desc: <Bright>Active:</Bright> Gain @ShieldCalc1@  Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to enemies in a cone. \n\n<Bright>Quest:</Bright> Each player combat, Ornn stores damage blocked as Forge Power, increased by @DamageTaken3StarScalar@ at 3-star. Gain an Artifact Anvil each time he gains enough Forge Power. <Rules>(Forge Power: </Rules>@Stack@<Rules> / </Rules>@GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>

spell.name: Javelin Toss
spell.desc: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright><Bright>:</Bright> Gain @BonusAttackSpeed@ Attack Speed for the next @NumEmpoweredAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced with javelins that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage. The 3rd attack instead targets the furthest enemy with the least items and deals @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim><dim>: Transform into a Melee cougar Assassin that swipes enemies.</dim>

spell.name: Spirit of Dread
spell.desc: Gain @Resists@ Armor and Magic Resist for 3 seconds and restore @HealthCalc1@  Health over the duration. Launch spectral riders at the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Forest's Flurry
spell.desc: Blink away from the current target, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage to them, and gain @AttackSpeedCalc1@  Attack Speed. \n\nEvery 4th cast consumes the Attack Speed granted from Forest's Flurry and fires a blast through the largest group of enemies that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

spell.name: Arise!
spell.desc: Gain @AttackSpeed@ Attack Speed and summon @SoldiersToSpawn@ soldiers for the next @NumAttacks@ attacks. These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage per attack.

spell.name: Uproot
spell.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Restore @HealthCalc2@  Health each second, tripled for @SpellMultiplierDuration@ seconds after casting.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Lunge out of the ground, Stunning adjacent enemies for @KnockupDuration@ second and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to them.

spell.name: Primordial Burst
spell.desc:
Launch a giant blast at the target that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, increased to @MagicDamageCalc2@  if they're below @HPThreshold@ max Health.

If they die, permanently gain @APOnKill@% Ability Power.

Current bonus: @Stack@%

spell.name: Sow the Seeds
spell.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> After every @DamageMitigatedPerSapling@ damage blocked, a sapling jumps towards a nearby enemy and deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage. On death, @SaplingsOnDeath@ saplings jump out.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Deal @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage to target and restore @HealthCalc1@  + @ActiveMissingHealthHeal@ missing Health.

spell.name: Petrified Bark
spell.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@  Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and become petrified. When the shield breaks, unleash a wave of dark energy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to enemies within @AoEHexRange@ hexes.

spell.name: Last Rites
spell.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> On death, spawn a Spirit Walker with @HealthCalc2@  max Health which immediately taunts, forcing enemies to attack it.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@  Health and strike the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage.

spell.name: Cultivation of Spirit
spell.desc: Dash, then launch an orb at the current target that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage and splits, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  physical damage to @NumSecondaryTargets@ nearby enemies.

spell.name: Haymaker
spell.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Upon falling below @ManaHPThreshold@ max Health the first time each combat, gain 100 mana.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Wind up a big punch, rapidly healing for @HealthCalc1@  before dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage in a large cone.

spell.name: Spirit Bomb
spell.desc: Launch a spirit bomb at the location within @AbilityCenterHexRange@ hexes that has the most surrounding enemies. It deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to enemies in a @HexRadius@ hex radius, reduced by @HexPercentDamageFalloffTooltip@ per hex away from the epicenter.

spell.name: Spirit Rift
spell.desc:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage, reduced by @DamageFalloffPerEnemy@ per enemy hit (minimum @MinDamagePercent@). If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.

The arrow leaves a trail for @RiftDuration@ seconds that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  + @MaxHealthDamagePerSecond@ max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and @ChillPercent@% <Keyword>Slows</Keyword> them.

<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</Rules>

spell.name: Spider Queen
spell.desc: Transform into a spider and gain @SpiderHealthBuff@ max Health. Attacks while in Spider Form deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  bonus magic damage and heal for @HealthCalc1@ . Subsequent casts grant @DecayingAS@ decaying Attack Speed for @ASBuffDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Headshot
spell.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every third attack is replaced with a Headshot that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage.

spell.name: Noxious Blast
spell.desc: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. Poisons stack.

spell.name: Withering Curse
spell.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a dark blast at @NumEnemiesCursed@ nearby enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to them and cursing them for @SpellDuration@ seconds. Then, spawn a @HexRangeAOE@ Hex withering zone for the same duration that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage per second. Cursed enemies take @MagicDamageCalc3@  more damage per curse.

spell.name: Entrancing Dance
spell.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@  Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then grant the ally who has dealt the most damage this combat @AttackSpeedCalc1@  decaying Attack Speed for @AttackSpeedDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Lilting Lullaby
spell.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@  Health and send @NumEnemiesToFireAt@ butterflies at nearby enemies. Enemies hit take @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage and Sleep for @SleepDuration@ seconds. If they take @DamageNeededToAwaken@ damage, they wake up and take an additional @WakeupDamage@ max Health magic damage.

spell.name: Dance of Life
spell.desc: Restore @HealthCalc1@  Health over @Duration@ seconds. The next attack is replaced with a bash that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage.

spell.name: Fungus Among Us
spell.desc:
Throw 2 clusters of mushrooms that deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to the @NumEnemiesHit@ nearest enemies. Then hurl a giant mushroom that deals @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage to the target.

Each cast has a @PercentChanceOfForage@ chance to forage an extra mushroom that can be collected for bonus effects.

<bright>Red:</bright> @RedRerolls@ Reroll  <Rules>(Reds Foraged: </Rules>@Stack@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>Green:</bright> @GreenHealth@ Tactician Health <Rules>(Greens Foraged:</Rules> @GenericCalc1@<Rules>)</Rules>
<bright>Yellow:</bright> @YellowXP@ XP <Rules>(Yellows Foraged:</Rules> @GenericCalc2@<Rules>)</Rules>

spell.name: Defensive Ball Curl
spell.desc: Taunt, forcing enemies to attack this champion. For @Duration@ seconds, gain @ShieldCalc1@  Shield and @ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resist.\n\nWhen the Shield breaks, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage to enemies in @DamageHexRange@ Hexes.

spell.name: Rage Gene
spell.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Gain @RagePerSecond@ Rage per second and @RagePerAttack@ Rage per attack. 

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within @TransformSearchRadius@ hexes. Then, deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@  physical damage to enemies within @TransformHexRadius@ hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by @GenericCalc1@ , and Stun them for @StunDuration@ second. Mega Gnar gains @HealthCalc1@ Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.

<Bright>Grab n' Throw:</Bright> Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage to them and @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

spell.name: Explosive Charge
spell.desc: Attach an explosive charge to the target that lasts @Duration@ seconds. While active, gain infinite range and @AttackSpeedCalc1@  Attack Speed. After the duration, the charge explodes and splits damage between all enemies within 2 hexes, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage + @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  for each attack while casting.\n\n<Rules>If an enemy with an explosive charge on them dies, it attaches to Tristana's new target.</Rules>

spell.name: Boomerang Blade
spell.desc: Throw a large crossblade that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage to the current target and bounces @NumBounces@ times between nearby enemies, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  physical damage each bounce. When this kills an enemy, bounce @BonusKillBounces@ additional times.

spell.name: Furious Fists
spell.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> On attack, restore @HealthCalc1@  Health.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Unleash a primal roar, restoring @HealthCalc3@  Health. Then gain @SpellAS@ Attack Speed, @SpellDurability@ Durability, and is unstoppable for @SpellDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Kunai Strike
spell.desc: <Bright>Adaptor </Bright><Bright>:</Bright> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage. If the target is <keyword>Burning</keyword>, deal an additional @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  damage.\n\n<dim>Adaptor </dim><dim>: If the Ability kills, cast it again.</dim>

spell.name: Piercing Arrow
spell.desc: Wind up, then fire an arrow at the most enemies in line with the target. It deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage to enemies hit, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinDamagePercent@).

spell.name: Tantrum
spell.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every second, restore @HealthCalc1@  Health and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to enemies within @PassiveHexRadius@ hex.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Deal @MagicDamageCalc3@  magic damage to enemies within @BigHexRadius@ hexes and Stun them for @StunDuration@ seconds, increased to @GenericCalc1@ seconds if the target is <Keyword>Burning</Keyword>.

<Rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target's max Health as true damage every second.</Rules>

spell.name: Firestorm
spell.desc: Charge up, gaining @APPerBurningEnemy@ Ability Power per <Keyword>Burning</Keyword> enemy. Then, gain @ShieldCalc1@  Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and rush through a nearby group of enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to each. \n\nAfter rushing, unleash a @FirestormHexRadius@ Hex firestorm that deals a total of @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage split among all enemies hit over @FirestormDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Moonlight's Onslaught
spell.desc: Equip Severum and swipe the target @GenericCalc1@  times over @Duration@ seconds, each dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage. \n\nAfter the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

spell.name: Pale Barrier
spell.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@ shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and send out @NumOrbs@ moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage.

spell.name: Moonfall
spell.desc: Rain @NumMoonshards@ moonshards split among the @NumEnemies@ nearest enemies, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage each.\n\nIf the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage split among all enemies.

spell.name: Shield Bash
spell.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> Start combat with @GenericCalc1@  bonus Armor and Magic Resist that decays over @DecayDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Bash the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Solar Judgement
spell.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Kayle ascends based on her star level, granting her stacking bonuses. 

<Bright>1st Ascension:</Bright> Attacks deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  bonus magic damage.
<Bright>2nd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks @ShredLevel@% <Keyword>Shred</Keyword> enemies hit for @ShredDuration@ seconds. 
<Bright>3rd Ascension:</Bright> Attacks fire waves, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage to all other units hit.
<Bright>4th Ascension:</Bright> Gain infinite range. Every @NumAttacksForBigWave4Star@rd wave is much larger.

<Rules>Shred: Reduce Magic Resist</Rules>

spell.name: Sun's Wrath
spell.desc: Gain @ShieldCalc1@  Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then cleave in a cone, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage and strike in a line, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage to enemies hit.

spell.name: Taste Their Fear
spell.desc: Leap to the farthest enemy within @LeapRangeHexes@ Hexes, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage. If they have no adjacent allies, deal @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage instead and gain @IsolateManaGrant@ mana.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}

spell.name: Savagery
spell.desc: Jump to the lowest percent Health enemy within @JumpHexRange@ hexes and stab them, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage. Then heal for @HealthCalc1@ , increased to up to @HealthCalc2@  based on their missing Health.{Augment.Variant.RivalsAugment.AbilityTooltip}

spell.name: Raining Artillery
spell.desc: <Bright>Adaptor</Bright> <Bright>:</Bright> Launch acid at the target and the other nearest enemy, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage. Enemies below @ADBonusDamageThreshold@ max Health take @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  physical damage instead.\n\n<dim>Adaptor</dim><dim>: Damages enemies over time.</dim>

spell.name: Rampant Growth
spell.desc: Spawn @NumPlantsToSpawn@ plants around the battlefield that attack the nearest enemy @ThornSpitterNumAttacks@ times. Each attack deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage.

spell.name: Harvest
spell.desc: Reduce the Magic Resist of the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies by @MRReduction@. Then drain life from them over @CastDuration@ seconds, healing for @HealthCalc1@  Health and dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to each over the duration.

spell.name: Starcall
spell.desc: Call down a star on the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage. If a star has previously fallen on them, call down @NumAdditionalStars@ additional stars that each deal @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage.

spell.name: Emerald Radiance
spell.desc: <Bright>Passive:</Bright> The first time Taric or his paired ally drops below @PassivePercentHealthThreshold@ Health, unleash emerald energy from both of them, granting @ShieldCalc1@  Shield to allies within @PassiveHexRadius@ Hexes for @PassiveShieldDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Bright>Active:</Bright> Restore @HealthCalc1@  Health. Taric and his paired ally deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  bonus magic damage on their next @NumAttacks@ attacks.

spell.name: Triggerseed
spell.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Shields from this Ability can critically strike with <Keyword>Precision</Keyword>. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Grant @NumAlliesToShield@ allies @ShieldCalc1@  Shield and @DamageAmpAmount@ Damage Amp for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage to enemies adjacent to them. After casting @CastThreshold@ times, also grant @AttackSpeed@ stacking Attack Speed to targets.

spell.name: Final Spark
spell.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@  mana. \n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the largest group of enemies that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit.

spell.name: Triumphant Roar
spell.desc: Roar, restoring @HealthCalc1@  Health, cleansing disables, and healing the two lowest percent Health allies for @HealthCalc2@ . Then slam the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage and Stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Whirling Death
spell.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage over @BleedDuration@ seconds. Every attack has a @GenericCalc1@  chance to deal @SpinningAxeDamageRatio@ bonus physical damage and apply @SpinningAxeBleedStacks@ bleeds instead.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal @PhysicalDamageCalc3@  physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing @GenericCalc2@  physical damage to enemies hit. If no enemies are hit refund @ManaRefund@ of mana spent.

spell.name: Heat Without Equal
spell.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Attacks deal @AttackAoERatio@ damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

<Bright>Active:</Bright> Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for @StunDuration@ seconds, gain @Omnivamp@ Omnivamp, and Ignite them for @IgniteDuration@ seconds.  Ignited enemies take @IgniteMaxHealthDamage@ max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

<Bright>Flame Breath:</Bright>  Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc2@  physical damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerHit@ for each enemy it passes through (minimum @MinimumDamageThreshold@.) Ignite those enemies for @IgniteDuration@ seconds.

Elder Dragon Buff: Damaging an enemy below @TraitExecuteThreshold@ Health executes them.

spell.name: Karmic Bond
spell.desc: Tether the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage over @TetherDuration@ seconds. Then release a burst of power around them, dealing @MagicDamageCalc2@  magic damage to all enemies in a @AoEHexRange@ Hex radius and @SlowPercent@% <keyword>Slowing</keyword> them for @SlowDuration@ seconds.\n\n<Rules>Slow: Reduce Attack Speed</Rules>

spell.name: Mirror Image
spell.desc: <bright>Passive:</bright> After player combat, your strongest LeBlanc has a @PercentChanceToPrint@ chance to create a copy of an ally on your board, increased by @PercentChanceToPrintKillBonus@ per takedown.\n\n<bright>Active:</bright> Launch a mirror image at the current target, dealing @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage and @MagicDamageCalc2@  to adjacent enemies.

spell.name: Wuju Style
spell.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</Bright> Every third attack is a Double Strike. On takedown, gain a burst of movement speed.

<Bright>Adaptor </Bright>: Double Strikes grant @AttackSpeedCalc1@  stacking Attack Speed.

<dim>Adaptor </dim><dim>: Double Strikes deal bonus damage and heal.</dim>

spell.name: Ki Barrier
spell.desc: Grant @ShieldCalc1@  Shield to Shen and @ShieldCalc2@  Shield to a nearby damaged ally for @MagicShieldDuration@ seconds. Both of their next @NumAttacksBuff@ attacks gain @AttackSpeedBuff@ Attack Speed and deal @MagicDamageCalc1@  bonus magic damage.

spell.name: Jaws of The Beast
spell.desc: Bite the current target, dealing @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage and healing for @GenericCalc1@  of the damage dealt. Gain @AttackSpeedBuff@ Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

spell.name: Defensive Sweep
spell.desc: Slice the target for @PhysicalDamageCalc1@  physical damage and gain @AbilityShield@ Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds.

spell.name: Final Spark
spell.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@  mana. 

<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit (minimum @MinimumFalloffDamageRatio@).

<bright>Blackthorn Bonus:</bright> Stuns targets hit for @BlackthornStunDuration@ second.

spell.name: Final Spark
spell.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@  mana. 

<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit (minimum @MinimumFalloffDamageRatio@).

<bright>Blossom Bonus:</bright> The first target hit is dealt @BlossomBonusDamageRatio@ bonus damage.

spell.name: Final Spark
spell.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@  mana. 

<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit (minimum @MinimumFalloffDamageRatio@).

<bright>Coven Bonus:</bright> Reduces the Armor and Magic Resist of targets hit by @CovenResistReduction@ for the rest of combat.

spell.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@  mana. 

<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit (minimum @MinimumFalloffDamageRatio@).

<bright>Elderwood Bonus:</bright> Casts grant all allies @ElderwoodHealthIncrease@ increased max Health for the rest of combat.

spell.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@  mana. 

<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit (minimum @MinimumFalloffDamageRatio@).

<bright>Fae Bonus:</bright> Heals the lowest percent Health ally for @FaeHealRatio@ of ability damage dealt.

spell.name: Final Spark
spell.desc:
<bright>Passive:</bright> On cast, all allies that share a trait with Lux gain @ManaCalc1@  mana. 

<bright>Active:</bright> Fire a laser towards the most enemies in a line that deals @MagicDamageCalc1@  magic damage, reduced by @DamageReductionPerUnit@ for each enemy hit (minimum @MinimumFalloffDamageRatio@).

<bright>Inferno Bonus:</bright> Restores @InfernoManaRestore@ mana per takedown.

spell.desc:
